categories.main_business_segments: AIG operates through three main business segments: General Insurance, Life and Retirement, and Other Operations. General Insurance is further divided into North America and International, offering commercial and personal insurance products. Life and Retirement includes Individual Retirement, Group Retirement, Life Insurance, and Institutional Markets. Other Operations primarily comprises corporate functions, asset management, and run-off portfolios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AIG's core operations rely on advanced actuarial modeling, risk assessment, and underwriting frameworks for insurance products. The company utilizes data analytics, digital platforms, and automated underwriting processes to enhance efficiency and customer experience. Investment management is tailored to match asset-liability profiles, with a focus on fixed income, structured securities, and alternative investments. AIG also employs sophisticated hedging and reinsurance strategies to manage risk.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AIG serves a broad range of customers including multinational corporations, small and medium-sized enterprises, institutional clients, and individual consumers. Key markets include commercial property and casualty insurance, retirement solutions for individuals and groups, and life insurance. The company also provides specialized products such as pension risk transfer, structured settlements, and stable value wraps.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIG has a global footprint, operating in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. Its largest markets are the United States, Japan, and the United Kingdom, with significant operations across Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and Bermuda. About 48% of employees are in North America, 32% in Asia Pacific, and the remainder in EMEA and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: AIG operates primarily as a downstream provider in the insurance and financial services supply chain, delivering end products and services directly to businesses and consumers. It also acts as a risk aggregator and capital manager, interfacing with reinsurers and capital markets to manage its own risk exposures.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AIG's strategic priorities include underwriting excellence, disciplined pricing, and risk management. The company is focused on separating its Life and Retirement business, modernizing its operating infrastructure through the AIG 200 initiative, and enhancing digital capabilities. ESG leadership, talent development, and diversity, equity, and inclusion are also emphasized. R&D efforts are directed at product innovation, digital transformation, and advanced analytics.
categories.revenue_model: AIG generates revenue primarily from insurance premiums, policy fees, and investment income. Additional revenue streams include asset management fees, advisory fees, and commissions. The company also earns income from reinsurance arrangements and, to a lesser extent, from the sale of investment products and services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIG competes with large multinational insurers (such as Chubb, Allianz, Zurich, MetLife, Prudential, and Manulife), as well as regional and specialty insurance companies and financial institutions. It is positioned as a leading global insurer with strong brand recognition, broad product offerings, and significant market share in commercial lines, retirement solutions, and specialty insurance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, AIG reported total revenues of $52.1 billion and shareholders’ equity of over $65 billion. The company demonstrated strong growth in net premiums written (up 13% in General Insurance) and solid performance in Life and Retirement, with assets under administration reaching $409 billion. AIG has returned significant capital to shareholders and reduced debt, while maintaining a focus on profitable growth and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIG differentiates itself through its global reach, comprehensive product portfolio, and expertise in underwriting complex risks. The company emphasizes financial strength, innovative solutions, and superior claims and risk management services. Its ability to serve both large multinational clients and individuals, combined with strong distribution relationships and a focus on customer-centric digital experiences, underpins its value proposition.
